blocks.text: Intuitive email marketing with powerful automation at an affordable price

MailerLite strikes the balance that most email marketing tools miss: powerful enough for serious marketing automation, simple enough that non-technical team members can use it confidently. The drag-and-drop editor produces professional emails without HTML knowledge, and the automation builder handles multi-step sequences with conditional logic.

For startups growing their email list, MailerLite includes landing page and form builders at no extra cost. You can create opt-in pages, pop-ups, and embedded forms that feed directly into your email segments - no need for a separate landing page tool.

The pricing is notably competitive. The free plan supports up to 1,000 subscribers with most features included, and paid plans start at $9/month. For bootstrapped teams, this means you can run sophisticated email marketing campaigns at a fraction of what Mailchimp or ConvertKit charges.
Visual email builder with responsive templates and blocks
Multi-step workflows with triggers, conditions, and actions
Built-in page builder for opt-ins and promotions
Group subscribers by behavior, interests, and engagement
Test subject lines, content, and send times to optimize performance
Shopify and WooCommerce integrations for product-based emails
MailerLite delivers 90% of what expensive email platforms offer at a fraction of the cost. For startups not yet ready for enterprise email tools, it is the smart choice.
Our team can integrate MailerLite into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
